verdict.rationale: Rippling advertises a general developer platform, APIs, and sandbox for building custom apps that touch HR/IT/finance data (rippling-docs-43, rippling-docs-47, rippling-docs-8), and HR data like new hires flows into payroll (rippling-docs-13), suggesting programmatic hiring workflows are conceivable. However there is no concrete documentation of specific API endpoints or an agent-usable workflow for creating an employee record, setting compensation, and configuring tax setup end-to-end — missing for 10: explicit employee-creation API reference, compensation-setup API, tax-setup API, and any example/agent integration demonstrating this end-to-end flow.
